Phase 1 mechanically enumerated 28 IN redeploy-remedy emission sites across 17 files (correcting every prior hand-compiled count, several never previously found). Phase 2 built scripts/lib/redeploy-remedy-lib.sh with its own 11-case suite, zero call sites converted. Three real regressions were found during this task's own verification passes and fixed as same-task follow-up commits: a shellcheck SC1090/SC2155 pair, a lint-json-channel-discipline.sh false-positive in orchestrate-batch-admit.sh, and a per-file eager-load ceiling overage in skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md (resolved by relocating detail plus a deliberate, reviewed ceiling move).
